purification_method: after activation washed several times with 1 M HCl at room temperature, then distilled water to neutral pH; dried at 120 C for 3 h

source_location: main article p. 1663 (page image main-06), Figure 7A, series 'LAC2600 Excess' (open grey circles)
notes: temperature printed as -196 C; archive: fig7A_LAC2600_excess.json; digitized marker centre (page-image pixel 734.5, 877.5); low-pressure region where markers of several series overlap; assignment of this marker to the series is less certain; H2 at -196 C (liquid nitrogen bath) on a Hiden IGA-003 intelligent gravimetric analyzer, 0-20 bar, H2 purity 99.9999%, buoyancy correction applied "as previously described"; outgassed under vacuum at 200 C overnight (duration not stated numerically); isotherm_point_count approximate: markers below ~1 bar overlap in the figure (see log.md); LAC2600 textural data (Table 2): BET area 1157 m2/g, t-plot micropore area 1123 m2/g, total pore volume 0.59 cm3/g (N2 at P/P0 = 0.99), t-plot micropore volume 0.54 cm3/g; NLDFT pore size distribution maxima 7/9/12 A; BET range: 0.02-0.25; N2 sorption at -196 C (Micromeritics ASAP 2020) after outgassing at 200 C for 12 h; average_pore_diameter_nm = 0.7 nm is the main NLDFT PSD maximum (7 A), which the text names as the one main maximum of the LAC2T samples; Table 1 composition: C 67.8, H 1.36, O 30.84 % (C/H 49.9); activated carbon yield 35.6 g/100 g hydrochar
